head:
For the target video, <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4> are referenced throughout.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action film footage of real actors in an ancient Chinese (Song-dynasty) period drama, shot on a cinema camera. Qin Shuang shown in <Picture 1> keeps exactly the same face, hair and costume as the pictures: East Asian young woman of twenty-one, striking fierce heroic beauty: bold straight brows, bright almond eyes with a confident glint and sharp eyeliner, high nose bridge, full lips, glowing light honey-toned skin, tall athletic figure with a toned silhouette and a strong cinched waist, sleek high ponytail tied with black cord, a fitted dark brown cotton short jacket crossed at the collar and cinched with a wide leather belt over fitted black trousers and leather boots; Wang Erniu shown in <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> (the same man from several angles) keeps exactly the same face, hair and costume as the pictures: East Asian young man of twenty-four, big and handsome in a simple way, square face, thick brows, an honest, guileless face, deeply sun-tanned, broad shoulders and back, an ancient Chinese Song-dynasty peasant's coarse brown hemp cross-collared short jacket with rolled sleeves, tied with a cloth sash; the location shown in <Picture 4> is the set, keeping its layout and props.
faces: Facial expressions follow the action and lines described below, not the reference pictures: the pictures fix the face, hair and costume only, never the mood.
silent: Everyone in the frame says nothing in this shot: their lips stay pressed together from the first frame to the last, no talking, no mouthing words, and the hazy white afternoon light stays unchanged.
shoes: Qin Shuang wears her leather boots and every other person in the frame dark cloth shoes on both feet.
tail:
One continuous shot. The picture is clean, with no subtitles, captions or text anywhere on screen; the air is clear and still, a clean natural film image. Natural, realistic human motion and acting of real actors: each person keeps the identity, hair and costume of their reference pictures, while every visible face acts the emotion written above and changes with it; the pictures are neutral studio portraits, never copy their blank expression.

A.result: This shot is one blow, and it ends like this: the whole hoe, wooden handle and iron blade together in one piece, has tumbled end over end up out of the top of the frame at the upper left; Wang Erniu stands with his two hands spread wide and empty above his head; Qin Shuang holds her carrying pole level across her chest in both hands. The carrying pole and the hoe handle are two separate shafts that touch at one single point for one instant.
A.composition: In the bamboo valley upstream of the dry Liuxi stream on the first afternoon of the drought, at the Qian family's dam, on the narrow stone-edged earth path at the foot of the bank of brown hemp sacks; hazy white afternoon sunlight, dust in the hot air: medium wide shot at standing eye height, the camera to the side of the two of them on the path, both side-on to us and seen whole from head to boots in the lower two thirds of the frame, clear sky and bamboo hill in the upper third above them; on the left third of the frame Wang Erniu, in his coarse brown cross-collared short jacket with the sleeves rolled up, his black hair tied up in one small round topknot on the crown of his head, his face tanned dark from the sun, facing screen right, one hoe with a plain wooden handle and an iron blade raised straight up above his head in both hands, both fists together at the lower end of the handle just above his head, the handle standing upright and the iron blade at its top, the whole hoe inside the frame with clear sky above its blade; his face in profile to screen right, never the lens; furious, not smiling: brows knotted, jaw clenched, his lips pressed shut, no smile at any moment, not even at the end of the shot, until the last frame; on the right third of the frame, one long step away from him with clear air between them, Qin Shuang, in her fitted dark brown cross-collared short jacket cinched with a wide plain black leather belt, black trousers and leather boots, her high ponytail tied with black cord, facing screen left toward him, one plain wooden carrying pole as long as she is tall, smooth and round to its ends, held low in both her hands at her right hip, its far end down near the earth between them, the carrying pole low and the hoe high, the two shafts far apart in the first frame; her face in profile to screen left, never the lens; cold and fast, not smiling: brows level, eyes hard, lips closed; far behind them, soft and small, the bank of brown hemp sacks rising at the right and beyond its top the muddy pond, where a short row of exactly fourteen men stands in the shallow water from the right edge of the frame to just right of the middle, the fourteenth man just right of the middle and beyond him only bare muddy water and the bamboo hill; the fourteen men are in identical Song-dynasty black cross-collared short jackets, black trousers with white cloth leg wraps below the knee and black cloth head wraps, each holding one plain wooden staff upright, small and out of focus, their faces three-quarter to screen left toward the two; the narrow muddy ditch at the left; their hands hold only what is described here; exactly sixteen people; exactly one hoe, his, and exactly one carrying pole, hers. Qin Shuang and Wang Erniu each appear once; no second copy of anyone appears.
A.action: Qin Shuang shifts her weight onto her back foot and sweeps the carrying pole up in one fast arc from low at her right hip to high above his head: its end strikes the middle of the upright hoe handle once from the right with a hard knock, the two wooden shafts crossing at one single point at a sharp angle for one instant; the whole hoe, wooden handle and iron blade together in one piece, flips out of his hands and tumbles end over end up and away to the upper left, out of the frame past the top edge in a moment; his two hands stay up above his head, fingers spread, empty; Qin Shuang draws the carrying pole back down and holds it level across her chest in both hands to the last frame; the fourteen men far away stay where they are;
A.camera: The camera holds a static shot.

B.action: In the first moment Qin Shuang dips the end of the carrying pole toward the earth and shifts her weight onto her back foot; in one fast upward sweep its end strikes the middle of the upright hoe handle once from the right with a hard knock, the two wooden shafts crossing at one single point at a sharp angle for one instant; at once the whole hoe, wooden handle and iron blade together in one piece, spins end over end high into the pale sky and leaves the frame past the top edge at the upper left; for the rest of the shot Wang Erniu stands frozen with his two hands spread wide and empty above his head, his face turned up after it, and Qin Shuang holds the carrying pole level across her chest in both hands, her eyes on him; the men at the right edge stay where they are;
